title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Psalms 31: Yahweh as rock and fortress, committing the spirit into his hand, and his great goodness to those who take refuge in him.

questions.text: Besides a strong rock, what does the psalmist ask Yahweh to be to him in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 31:2 says, 'Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.'

questions.text: Out of what does the psalmist ask to be plucked?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, 'Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me.'

questions.text: What does the psalmist commend into Yahweh's hand?
questions.explanation: Psalms 31:5 says, 'Into your hand I commend my spirit.'

questions.text: Whom does the psalmist say he hates in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, 'I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.'

answers.text: Those who live in the city

questions.text: Where has Yahweh set the psalmist's feet?
questions.explanation: Psalms 31:8 says, 'You have set my feet in a large place.'

questions.text: To what does the psalmist compare himself in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, 'I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.'

questions.text: What does the psalmist say is in Yahweh's hand in verse 15?
questions.explanation: Psalms 31:15 says, 'My times are in your hand.'

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh's face to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says, 'Make your face to shine on your servant.'

questions.text: Where did Yahweh show the psalmist his marvelous loving kindness?
questions.explanation: Psalms 31:21 says he has shown him his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

questions.text: What did the psalmist say in his haste?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says, 'As for me, I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before your eyes."'

answers.text: "I am cut off from before your eyes."
"I will go back to my father's house."
